what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Senegal in all host countries combined: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 38978 asylum seekers from Senegal.
The United States hosts the largest share, 56.7%, followed by Spain, Canada and Italy.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Casamance territory in Senegal in some years from 1995 to 2011, with the MFDC in 2003 and 2011.
The fact pack records no armed conflict in Senegal in recent years, so it does not say why the number of asylum seekers grew.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 914 asylum seekers.
The figure reached its highest point, 39749, at the end of 2024, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2017 and 2024 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals of asylum seekers summed over every host country; refugees from Senegal are counted separately.
